title: Fondamantal — Digital Album Player
label: Album Experience / Productized Media
summary: An album-centric experience designed to preserve sequencing, identity, and narrative context inside a brand-owned platform.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Digital Album Player presents releases as cohesive digital products—encouraging complete listening rather than fragmented track consumption.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.body: Albums are often consumed out of sequence with little continuity or brand ownership when hosted purely on third-party platforms.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.body: A focused album view that preserves sequencing, integrates artwork, minimizes distractions, and aligns with the broader platform's visual language.

sections.title: Key Features
bullets: Album-centric layout unifying artwork, tracklist, and controls
Sequential playback designed for album flow
Minimal UI to keep focus on the music

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: A controlled, immersive release experience that strengthens engagement and positions the platform as a destination.

sections.title: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Productizing content creates deeper engagement and long-term brand value.

cta.headline: Launching a digital product or media experience?
cta.body: If you want releases to feel cohesive and intentional, I can help structure the experience.
